xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3114: UAT-promoted merges leave DoD row 3 (verification) permanently unsatisfiable — same shape as the PAN-3067 strike gap

plan.title: UAT-promoted merges leave DoD row 3 (verification) permanently unsatisfiable — same shape as the PAN-3067 strike gap
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Operator promotion of a UAT generation merges the tested batch to main, but members whose branch never got a pre-merge verification-runner run are left with verificationStatus: pending forever. The runner is pre-merge and branch-scoped, so once the batch merges nothing can ever satisfy DoD row 3, and close-out is permanently blocked except by an --accept-verification override on issues that are merged, deployed, and green (observed on PAN-3037, batch uat/pan-cedar-0726). Structurally identical to the PAN-3067 strike gap: a legitimate landing path discards evidence the system already has — with require_uat_before_merge, operator UAT IS the verification step.
narratives.Proposal: Record the evidence where it exists, mirroring PAN-3067: (1) after promoteUatGeneration successfully promotes a batch, stamp each non-terminal member's verificationStatus 'passed' through the review-status write door with notes naming source uat-promotion, the generation name, and the promote merge SHA (never overwriting terminal verdicts; recording failures never fail the promote); (2) closeOut() gains a visible pre-gate 'dod:uat-promotion-evidence' step that heals members of already-promoted generations so past cases like PAN-3037 close out on recorded evidence; (3) docs name uat-promotion as a row-3 verdict source.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to memberEligibility — promotion does not start requiring a passed verification gate
- No change to the verification runner; it stays pre-merge and branch-scoped
- No heal for testStatus (row 2) — only the verification row has the gap
- No change to processResyncReviewStatus's non-mutating contract
- No retroactive stamping of historical records outside the close-out heal path

autoDecisions.rationale: The operator exercised the batch stack and promoted it — real human verification, stronger than the automated gate; 'skipped' would understate recorded evidence. DoD row 3 accepts both.

autoDecisions.summary: Heal lives in closeOut() as a pre-gate step, not in pan review resync or the dod-gate checks
autoDecisions.rationale: processResyncReviewStatus is deliberately non-mutating and dod-gate row checks are read-only; closeOut is the single chokepoint shared by CLI, dashboard, and flywheel auto-close-out, and the heal shows up as a visible ceremony step.

autoDecisions.summary: Recorder is an optional injected dep on UatPromoteDeps in a new uat-promote-verification.ts module
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps promoteUatGeneration pure/testable, guarantees every promote path records, follows the PAN-3067 ratchet pattern of housing verdict recording in a dedicated module, and existing tests compile unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: lastVerifiedCommit = member.headSha; promote merge SHA goes in verificationNotes
autoDecisions.rationale: headSha is the commit review anchored and the operator exercised, keeping drift comparisons consistent; the merge SHA in notes preserves main-side traceability.

items.title: Create uat-promote-verification module with stamp builder and verdict recorder

expected_outputs: uat-promote-verification.test.ts passes (stamp shape, note contents, terminal-verdict preservation, anchor behavior)

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/uat-promote-verification.ts exporting buildUatPromotionStamp(current, member, evidence) and recordUatPromotionVerdicts(gen, mergeSha), per PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-3114.md). buildUatPromotionStamp returns {} when current.verificationStatus is 'passed' or 'skipped' (terminal, PAN-3067 precedent), otherwise { verificationStatus: 'passed', verificationNotes: 'uat-promotion: operator UAT of batch <name> promoted to main at <sha9> (PAN-3114)', lastVerifiedCommit: rehydrateHeadAnchor(member.headSha) when headSha non-empty }. recordUatPromotionVerdicts loops gen.members, applies the stamp via getReviewStatusSync/setReviewStatusSync (write door, src/lib/review-status.ts:147), logs each stamped issue, and returns the stamped issue IDs. Write tests/unit/lib/cloister/uat-promote-verification.test.ts covering: stamp shape and note contents, terminal-verdict preservation (passed and skipped), headSha-present/absent anchor behavior, and multi-member recording.

items.title: Given a member with verificationStatus 'pending', buildUatPromotionStamp returns a 'passed' stamp whose notes contain 'uat-promotion', the generation name, and the 9-char merge SHA
Given a member with verificationStatus 'passed' or 'skipped', buildUatPromotionStamp returns {} and recordUatPromotionVerdicts preserves the existing verdict and notes
Given a member with a non-empty headSha, the stamp's lastVerifiedCommit equals rehydrateHeadAnchor(headSha); given an empty headSha, the stamp omits lastVerifiedCommit
Given a generation with mixed terminal and non-terminal members, recordUatPromotionVerdicts returns exactly the non-terminal member issue IDs and persists their stamps through setReviewStatusSync
Record verification verdicts at UAT promote time via injected dep

expected_outputs: uat-promote.test.ts passes including new recorder-call assertions

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-2. Add optional dep `recordVerification?: (gen: UatGeneration, mergeSha: string) => void` to UatPromoteDeps in src/lib/cloister/uat-promote.ts (after the memberEligibility field, ~line 71). In promoteUatGeneration, immediately after `deps.store.update(gen.name, { status: 'promoted' })` (line 175), call `deps.recordVerification?.(gen, mergeSha)` inside try/catch that logs on error (a recording failure must never change the promote result — the merge has landed). In src/dashboard/server/services/uat-train.ts postUatGenerationPromotePayload (lines 373-388), wire the real recorder: `recordVerification: (gen, mergeSha) => recordUatPromotionVerdicts(gen, mergeSha)` via dynamic import of '../../../lib/cloister/uat-promote-verification.js' (same style as the flywheel-merge-order.js import at line 377). Extend tests/unit/lib/cloister/uat-promote.test.ts: spy dep called with (gen, mergeSha) on success; NOT called on not-found, wrong-status, member-not-ready, stale-base, or merge-failed; a throwing recorder leaves the success result unchanged.

items.title: Given a successful promote, the recordVerification dep is invoked once with the generation object and the merge SHA before promoteUatGeneration returns
Given each failure path (not-found, wrong-status, member-not-ready, stale-base, merge-failed), the recorder is never invoked
Given a recorder that throws, promoteUatGeneration still returns success with the same mergeSha and members
Given postUatGenerationPromotePayload, the deps passed to promoteUatGeneration include a recordVerification that delegates to recordUatPromotionVerdicts
Heal past UAT promotions in closeOut before the DoD gate

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-3. Add healUatPromotionVerification(issueId, deps?) to src/lib/cloister/uat-promote-verification.ts: resolve projectRoot via resolveProjectFromIssueSync; list promoted generations via listUatGenerationsSync({ projectRoot, statuses: ['promoted'] }) (src/lib/overdeck/merge-sync.ts:478); pick the latest by updatedAt containing issueId as a member; if the member's verdict is non-terminal, recover the promote merge SHA best-effort via execFileAsync git log --fixed-strings --grep="Merge UAT batch <name>" --format=%H -1 origin/main (message format from buildPromoteMergeMessage) and stamp via the same buildUatPromotionStamp guard; return { generation, mergeSha? } or null. Wire into closeOut() in src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts immediately before the evaluateDodGate call (line 175): push stepOk('dod:uat-promotion-evidence', [...]) naming the generation and short SHA when healed, stepSkipped(...) otherwise; the heal call is wrapped so an error yields the skipped step, never aborts close-out. Tests: heal stamps a pending/missing verdict with evidence, no-ops on terminal verdicts / non-members / unresolvable projects, still stamps when SHA recovery fails (note omits SHA), and closeOut shows the step with row 3 subsequently passing without --accept-verification.

items.title: Given an issue that is a member of a promoted generation with verificationStatus 'pending', healUatPromotionVerification records the 'passed' verdict and returns the generation name and recovered merge SHA
Given an issue with a terminal verdict, no promoted membership, or an unresolvable project, healUatPromotionVerification returns null and writes nothing
Given merge-SHA recovery fails, the heal still stamps the verdict with notes naming the generation and no SHA

Given closeOut runs for a healable issue, the ceremony output includes a passing 'dod:uat-promotion-evidence' step and the DoD verification row passes on the recorded verdict without any --accept-verification flag
Document uat-promotion as a DoD row 3 verdict source

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4. In docs/DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md row 3 (line 15), add 'uat-promotion (recorded at batch promotion, PAN-3114)' to the Mechanical owner cell, and add one sentence to the PAN-3067 bullet (lines 43-46) stating that UAT batch promotion records the per-member verdict at promote time and close-out heals members of past promotions. Keep the table shape intact — tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-doc-drift.test.ts drift-locks this table to src/lib/lifecycle/dod.ts. In docs/UAT-BATCH-TRAINS.md (promotion section, near line 110), document that promotion records verificationStatus 'passed' per member with source uat-promotion, that terminal verdicts are preserved, and that close-out heals members of previously promoted generations.

items.title: docs/DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md row 3's Mechanical owner cell contains 'uat-promotion (recorded at batch promotion, PAN-3114)' and the PAN-3067 rules bullet states that promotion records the per-member verdict and close-out heals past promotions
docs/UAT-BATCH-TRAINS.md states that promotion records per-member verification verdicts, preserves terminal verdicts, and that close-out heals past promotions
